title: Each message shows its time in its border
body:
coax draws your prompts and the agent's replies in rounded boxes (`bubble` and `framed` in `ui.rs`). `Entry::User` and `Entry::Agent` in `session.rs` hold only the message's text, so the transcript shows nothing about when a message was sent.

## Proposal

- `Entry::User` and `Entry::Agent` carry the local time the message began. For a prompt, that is when you sent it. For a reply, it is when its first chunk arrived.
- The top border shows the time, dim, as `HH:MM`, at the corner nearest the screen edge. That puts it on the right for your prompts and on the left for replies. A message from an earlier day also shows the date.
- The time is left out when the box is too narrow to hold it.

## Open

- Does the Claude adapter's history replay on `session/load` carry each message's time, in `_meta` or elsewhere? If it does not, a resumed session's messages have no times, and only messages from this run show one. This needs a trial against the adapter.
- Should a reply also show how long the turn took, as in `14:32 · 41s`?

notes.author: Jack Roddy/bd10c4a0
notes.text: Jack, 2026-11-10: a reply shows the turn's length after the time, as in `14:32 · 41s`. Check the adapter's code for times in its history replay first. With none, a resumed session's older messages show no time.
